title: Bike Courier
summary: Pick up a package at McShane and ride it to O'Hare Hall before time runs out.

offer: We've got a package here for a student over in O'Hare Hall, and it needs to get there fast.
You've got a bike. Can you run it over?
requires_say: I need a fast courier for a delivery to O'Hare Hall.
Borrow a bike from the rack outside Walsh Library, then come back and see me!
decline_say: Okay. Come back if you change your mind!

teaches: O'Hare Hall on the east side
Getting round fast on the bike

say: Great! The package is waiting at McShane's front door, just east of here. Grab it and the clock starts.

steps.name: package
steps.hint: It's at McShane's front door, just east of the Mail Room Staffer.
say: You picked up the package. Ride to O'Hare Hall, quick!

steps.label: Deliver the package to O'Hare Hall
steps.hint: O'Hare is on the east side: east along Constitution Row, then south. Press X to hop on your bike.
fail_say: Out of time! The package went back to McShane. Pick it up and try again.

done_say: Nice riding! Your bike is maroon now: courier colors.
